title: Fan Project – Digimon GO-style game.
author: Joaovscau
selftext:
I'm making a Digimon fan game based on Pokémon GO, with the aesthetic of the movie \*Digimon War Game\*. I'd love to hear your opinions, suggestions for improvement, and feedback.

This is a personal project I've been working on for a few years. I was able to pick it back up thanks to the rise of AI. Because one of the SDKs I was using was deprecated, I ended up putting the project on hold, but I resumed working on it a little over a month ago.

replies.author: Joaovscau
replies.body: It's still in development right now, but once it's in the testing phase, I'll definitely make it available!
